title: Image Prompt Library — query output contract
description: What the QUERY operation returns (SPEC section 7, query/runbook.md). NEVER-EMPTY RULE: every image slot returns at least one renderable option. Stage 1 derives candidates from registry/index.yaml — channel legality from each type's own channels, then attribute gates, then role affinity from step+job — so a slot cannot run out while any type on the channel can carry the argument. An image slot with zero options is a contract violation, not a valid state.

awareness_stage.description: INFERRED from the page's own copy — the section structure, what the hero assumes the reader already believes, how much the page spends re-establishing the problem. Not an input field: the content says it, so declaring it separately would add a surface that can go stale against the copy it describes. Record the basis for the inference in page_composition_notes. It is the weight the coverage pass uses; an absent ladder rung is not a gap unless this stage says it is.

asset.description: Canonical output filename the page layout references. Option renders are suffixed --A/--B/--C; the picked one is renamed to this.

placement.description: Where the asset sits on the page, named against the input's own section keys.

out_of_scope_reason.description: Only legal for slots that carry NO image by definition: the cta cell (standard product shot) and text furniture such as comment threads or pricing tables. An image slot may never use it — Stage 1 derivation always yields candidates.

varies_on.description: The named dimension this option varies on: 'baseline', 'type: <id>', 'axis: <axis>=<value>', or 'execution: <what>'. G5 decision — picks are only interpretable if this is honest.

ratio.description: Slot requirement, passed as the generation aspect-ratio PARAMETER. Never written into the prompt text — adapters/nano-banana.md Rule 4, 6/6 renders ignored a written ratio.

steps.description: Required when pipeline is multi-pass: the ordered generate/edit/composite script from the adapter.

asset_candidate.description: Filename to render this candidate as, e.g. 'page-01-hero--A.jpg'.

avoid.description: The adapter-rendered exclusion line(s) for models without a negative channel.

form.description: whole-frame = the whole image becomes a short loop, available to any type because it adds no layer. inset = the motion replaces a layer the type's SKELETON already legislates; never proposes a NEW layer.

kind.description: What the loop ARGUES, from the `jobs` vocabulary. It is the job of the LAYER the loop lives in, which is often not the type's own job — an inset is not a pain slot. For form 'whole-frame' there is no layer, so it is the type's own job. Sets what SHOT, ACTION and RESULT name; nothing else about the plate changes with it.

reason.description: Why this slot does or does not earn motion — the temporal test applied to the slot's declared purpose.

asset.description: Filename of the PLATE render. It carries the --brief suffix and is never the slot's own asset filename: the plate is a production-only work order and a page asset carrying one is a defect (G12).

prompt.description: The prompt that RENDERS the motion brief plate — the five-field work order drawn into a frame, so the editor who builds the loop reads it off the render (G12, ADR-019). Never a prompt that animates a supplied still: this pipeline does not composite, an editor does. Two shapes only. For form 'whole-frame' the plate IS the delivered image, a flat card carrying the five lines and nothing else — no scene, no product. For form 'inset' the host type's own prompt sets its legislated layer to --loop and draws the plate there, geometry inherited from that layer.

type_id.description: The gif type this loop is filed under, from vocabulary.gif_types and defined in registry/gif-types/<id>.md. It equals `kind` for every routable type — a loop argues one thing and the id IS that argument (ADR-023). `unboxing` is never emitted here: it is ad-channel only.

rung.description: How this loop was earned (query/runbook.md Step 5d). 'natural' = the slot passes the temporal test as routed. 're-execution' = the slot's still execution earns no motion but a different staging of the same argument does, most often a locked multi-panel proof restaged as one continuous frame; say which in `reason`. 'ambient' is off by default and appears only when the owner switched it on for this page.

refs.description: Where the editor looks for precedent: the library folder for this type, plus one or two filenames from it. Not drawn into the plate — the plate keeps its five lines (G12); this travels in prompts.md.

output.description: The filename the editor returns, for BOTH forms: the slot's own `asset` with the extension changed to .mp4. Distinct from `asset`, which names the production-only plate and carries --brief. The library name ({type}_{product-slug}_{seq}) is issued separately by ingestion/gifs.jsonl when the finished loop is filed back.

recommended_opt.description: Which option this operation recommends. Required whenever the slot has options. The reasoning goes in recommendation_basis — an unexplained pick is not interpretable later, and picks.jsonl records what the human chose, not what was suggested.

recommendation_basis.description: Why that option won, named against the stated criteria in page_composition_notes. Must cite the criteria that decided it, not restate the option.

recommended_media.description: Which medium this operation recommends for the slot. Default 'still'. 'gif' says the slot's argument is carried better by the loop than by any of A/B/C — the recommended still is still emitted and still rendered, because the loop is an order to an editor and the page must ship today (ADR-020). Explain it in recommendation_basis.

coverage.description: Evidence for `recommended[]`: which Trust Ladder rungs the routed slots cover, which are absent, and whether the awareness stage makes each absence a gap or a correct omission.

absent_but_correct.description: Rungs missing on purpose for this awareness stage — recorded so a later reader does not 'fix' them.

gaps.description: Absent rungs the awareness stage says DO matter. Each must have a matching entry in recommended[].

recommended.description: Product-driven proposals the page did not ask for. Same option shape as a slot, plus earns_its_place and suggested_placement. Additive only — never counted as page sections, never silently added to the asset manifest.

earns_its_place.description: Which ladder rung it fills and why the awareness stage makes that rung matter. A proposal that cannot name its rung is decoration and does not ship.

motion.description: The page's motion budget (query/runbook.md Step 5d). Emitted on every routed page, including pages that carry no motion at all — a stated zero is actionable and a missing block is not.

floor.description: Minimum loops this page must carry. Owner standing instruction 2026-08-19: 2.

ceiling.description: Maximum loops the page may carry: 5, with at most one per section and never two in adjacent slots.

groups_covered.description: Which halves of the floor the delivered loops cover, read from each type's `group`. One of each is the preference, not a gate — a page whose natural pair is two `working` loops keeps it and says so rather than restaging a strong slot to fill a column.

shortfall_reason.description: Required non-null when delivered < floor. Names which slots were examined at rung 2 and why none of them earned motion. Never filled by switching ambient on: a page that cannot argue in motion says so (SPEC 7.5's rule that an absence is not automatically a gap, applied to motion).

notes.description: Spacing conflicts resolved, sections that lost a loop to the one-per-section rule, wall verdicts.
